questions.text: When will Cedar’s new customer portal launch, who owns the launch, and what is confirmed about its scope?

answers.text:
The operations update lists October 25 as the customer portal launch target. The product update says the customer portal launch is targeted for October 18.
It also names Mira Chen as launch readiness coordinator. It names Mira Chen, the product lead, as the person coordinating launch readiness.
The Cedar customer portal is intended to let customers view their open support cases and update contact details. The product group has signed off those two capabilities for the first release.

evidence.heading: Portal launch note
evidence.content:
The Cedar customer portal is intended to let customers view their open support cases and update contact details. The product group has signed off those two capabilities for the first release. The note does not approve payment history or invoice downloads for the first release.

An internal preview has been running with employees. Preview availability should not be confused with a customer launch, which requires a separate readiness decision.
